meta.name: knowledge-ops
meta.description: Audit and repair an internal knowledge base — staleness, ownership gaps, orphans, duplication, and findability. Use when the wiki is untrusted, docs are out of date, nobody owns pages, or search returns the wrong answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清查内部知识库,修复过时与重复内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队维基过时、重复,搜索常常找不到对的东西
copy.tagline_en: Audit your internal knowledge base to fix stale and duplicated content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team wiki is outdated and search often fails

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能按文档清单审计内部知识库:按关键程度与更新时间给文档打分,找出孤儿页、失效链接、重复页等问题,标出缺负责人的页面,再排出修复优先级并给出删除、合并或补链接的建议。
howto.when: 当你说知识库不可信、文档过期或没人负责页面等,或要做入职/并购前的文档审计时触发。

say.text: 审计 docs 目录,按今天日期给知识库健康度打分
say.note: 运行健康审计并输出分数与问题清单。

say.text: 找出知识库里没人链接也没人访问的孤儿页面
say.note: 列出候选删除的孤儿页。

say.text: 把重复的入职文档合并到被引用最多的那一篇
say.note: 按入链数选保留版本并建议重定向。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can audit a knowledge base: score docs by criticality/freshness, find orphans, dead links, duplicates and missing owners, rank fixes, suggest deletion, merge, or link repair.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say the wiki is untrusted, docs are outdated, or nobody owns pages, etc.; also for doc audits before onboarding or acquisitions.

say_en.text: Audit the docs directory and score knowledge-base health as of today.
say_en.note: Runs the health audit and prints score plus issues.

say_en.text: Find orphan pages that nobody links to and nobody visits.
say_en.note: Lists pages that are candidates for deletion.

say_en.text: Merge the duplicate onboarding docs into the most-linked one.
say_en.note: Keeps the version with most inbound links and suggests redirects.
